name: bulesky
description: 心灵星空 — an anonymous, borderless starry-sky whisper box.

scripts.db:migrate:local: for f in migrations/*.sql; do wrangler d1 execute bulesky-db --local --file="$f"; done
scripts.db:migrate:remote: for f in migrations/*.sql; do wrangler d1 execute bulesky-db --remote --file="$f"; done
